entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I ordered a new cycling jersey last week, and it just doesn't fit right. I need to see about an exchange.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue like the fit?
It's the fit. I got my usual size, but this model seems to be a much slimmer cut. It's just too tight across the shoulders. I definitely ordered the wrong size for this style.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for comfort on a ride. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF88675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order right here. The VeloFit Pro-Line Jersey, delivered six days ago. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard apparel.
Oh, that's great. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file now. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we can get the correct size shipped out to you.

That's perfect. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and heading to the post office, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase? Say, 10% for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard size exchange, I can confirm that the shipping for your new, larger-sized jersey will be completely free of charge. We'll get that sent out the moment the original item is scanned in by the carrier.
Okay, free shipping on the replacement works for me. That's a fair solution. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label should be in your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and happy riding.
